description: This file defines a singleton object ApiClient responsible for creating Retrofit API service instances for product, order, and cart APIs in an online shopping platform. It configures network settings, including timeouts and HTTP logging, and provides factory methods for API interfaces.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A singleton object providing factory methods to create API service instances (ProductApi, OrderApi, CartApi) configured with Retrofit for network communication.

methods.name: createRetrofit
methods.description: Creates and configures a Retrofit instance with the provided base URL, Moshi converter, HTTP client with logging and timeout settings.

methods.name: createProductApi
methods.description: Returns a ProductApi service instance using Retrofit with default or specified base URL.

methods.name: createOrderApi
methods.description: Returns an OrderApi service instance using Retrofit with default or specified base URL.

methods.name: createCartApi
methods.description: Returns a CartApi service instance using Retrofit with default or specified base URL.
